1101 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not by 400).  
Days in Sept 1101: 30.  
Back up:  
Oct 9 → Sep 9: 30 days earlier → 209 days left.  
Aug 31 days → Aug 9: 31 days earlier → 178 days left.

Feb 28 days → Feb 12: 28 days earlier → -3 days left means we overshot by 3 days.  
So from Mar 9, go back 25 more days:  
Mar 9 → Feb 12 (25 days earlier) is correct.  
Now check: From 1101-10-09 back 239 days:  
Days from Feb 12 to Oct 9 in 1101:  
Feb: 28-12 = 16 days left in Feb.  
Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 9.  
Sum = 16+31+30+31+30+31+31+30+9 = 239 days. Correct.  

So date is 1101-02-12.
